messages:
teja: Sealing candidate build now — artifact 7a9f3e. Change window 03/24 11:00-12:00 PST. Need SRE/QA/Product +1s before promote.

maria: Staging smoke looks good. No JSON-LD regressions. Artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/7a9f3e

owen: SRE +1 pending telemetry sanity run. I'll kick off kv-warm and tail errors.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promote_request created for candidate 7a9f3e -> prod window 11:00 PST. To promote: `/deploy promote 7a9f3e --window=11:00`

sasha: QA +1. Ran full prompt-eval; minor token drift in summarization (0.6% recall drop). Documented in QA notes, acceptable for this release.

teja: @sre-oncall any objections on latency? We expect ~5% p50 change from attention kernel tweak.

sre-oncall: Preflight traces look ok — p50 flat, p95 +3% which is within SLO slack. I'll monitor closely during rollout.

product-desk: Release notes updated: https://confluence/redwood/release/7a9f3e — callout for prompt-eval change + fallback routing.

owen: Pinning model variant to `v2-q4` for this candidate to avoid quant edgecases. Command used: `kubectl set image rc-7a9f3e model_image=redwood/model:v2-q4`

maria: Reminder: rollback playbook at oncall-runbook#deploy-rollback. High-level steps: revert routing -> scale down new pods -> re-pin to last-good 6b4f1c.

sasha: Proposing canary ramp: 5% for 15m, then 33% for 15m, then full. Abort if errors >1% or latency >30% baseline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary ramp: 5% @11:05 for 15m, 33% @11:25 for 15m, full @11:45. Cancel window reserved 11:00-12:30.

teja: All signoffs present. I'll trigger promote at 11:00 and own the rollout. If issues, @sre-oncall and @maria to execute rollback.

sre-oncall: Oncall ready and monitoring.

maria: Copy. Tagging release-notes with internal rollback template.

owen: :thumbsup: KV warm job queued, will start 10:50.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promotion started by teja at 11:00. Step 1 -> deploy to canary nodes. Logs: `tail /var/log/deploy/7a9f3e.log`

teja: Canary is up. Observability looks clean, p95 within expected. Proceeding to 33%.

sre-oncall: Observability alert: increased 500s on worker-3 at 11:12, spike from 0.02% -> 0.9%. Taking action: rolling back worker-3 to older image to stabilize.

teja: Acknowledged. Pausing ramp. Investigating whether attention tweak caused worker CPU/memory anomaly. Maria — any QA signal?

maria: No clear correlation from prompt sets. Re-deploying canary with earlier worker image pinned. If stable 5m, we can resume ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback executed on worker-3 -> reverted to image 6b4f1c at 11:15.

sre-oncall: Errors dropped to baseline by 11:18. Resuming canary ramp at 11:20 with a 10% hold.

teja: Resumed ramp and watching metrics. I'll update release notes with a short incident note.

product-desk: Noted. Drafting external blurb and omitting transient worker detail.

sasha: QA re-ran failing prompt set against active canary after rollback — no regressions observed.

teja: Proceeding to full promote at 11:40. Thanks all. Post-deploy readout planned 12:00 to close out.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promotion complete at 11:46. Final status: success. Release artifact 7a9f3e; tags: v2-q4 pinned. Change window closed 12:00.
